2607.24276.title: The Tokenizer Tax: Quantifying and Explaining the Cross-Lingual Cost of Subword Tokenization for Indian Languages
2607.24276.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) process text through subword tokenizers rather than directly reading characters or words. Because these tokenizers are trained predominantly on English-centric corpora, they introduce a systematic and often overlooked disadvantage for many non-English languages. In this work, we quantify this tokenizer tax for Indian languages using the FLORES-200 parallel corpus, measuring tokenization fertility across six widely used tokenizers and fourteen languages. Under cl100k_base (used by GPT-3.5 and GPT-4), Indian languages experience an average 8.0x tokenization tax relative to English, reaching 13.0x for Malayalam, reducing the effective context window to as little as 12% of that available to English users for equivalent semantic content. We identify the primary mechanism behind this disparity: failed byte-pair merges that leave text fragmented into single-byte tokens, with merge failure strongly correlating with tokenizer tax (Pearson r = 0.89). We further show that this phenomenon is not an inherent property of Indic scripts but a consequence of tokenizer design. Multilingual tokenizers such as XLM-R and OpenAI's o200k_base reduce the average Indic tokenizer tax by 73%, demonstrating that the disparity is largely remediable. Beyond token statistics, we quantify a practical consequence by showing that, under fixed context budgets, Indian-language documents preserve substantially less original content than equivalent English documents. Finally, we examine the relationship between tokenizer fertility and reading comprehension performance on the Belebele benchmark, finding that the apparent correlation is largely explained by language resource availability rather than tokenizer behavior alone.
2607.24276.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）通過子詞標記器處理文本，而不是直接讀取字符或單詞。由於這些標記器主要在以英語為中心的語料庫上進行訓練，它們為許多非英語語言引入了一種系統性且常被忽視的劣勢。在這項工作中，我們使用FLORES-200平行語料庫量化印度語言的標記器稅，測量六種廣泛使用的標記器和十四種語言的標記化生育率。在cl100k_base（由GPT-3.5和GPT-4使用）下，印度語言相對於英語經歷了平均8.0倍的標記化稅，馬拉雅拉姆語的標記化稅達到13.0倍，將有效上下文窗口縮減至英語用戶可用的相同語義內容的12%。我們確定了這種差異的主要機制：失敗的字節對合併使文本碎片化為單字節標記，合併失敗與標記器稅之間存在強相關性（Pearson r = 0.89）。我們進一步表明，這一現象並不是印度文字的固有特性，而是標記器設計的結果。多語言標記器如XLM-R和OpenAI的o200k_base將平均印度標記器稅降低了73%，顯示出這種差異在很大程度上是可以修正的。除了標記統計外，我們還量化了一個實際後果，顯示在固定的上下文預算下，印度語言文件保留的原始內容顯著少於等效的英語文件。最後，我們檢查了標記器生育率與Belebele基準上的閱讀理解表現之間的關係，發現明顯的相關性主要是由語言資源的可用性解釋，而不僅僅是標記器行為。
2607.24276.author: Priyansh Srivastava et.al.
